status: PASS of source, selected parts, physical pins and conditional arithmetic only
local_bom_policy: Validate ignored local BOM if present; absence is not a build claim

upstream_cutoff.current_limit_evidence: scaled 5.36k specified bounds; 5.9k series network not independently specified
qualification_limits: No bound on assembly pulse overshoot or OVP maximum delay
Thermal resistance depends on actual RTN copper, vias and enclosure
No guaranteed OVP off-leakage/bleed discharge-time bound
Startup includes unknown active ST draw and downstream BQ dynamic load; estimated capacitor inrush only

limits: Typical capacitor curves and conditional resistor/PNP/current allowances do not establish worst-case silicon behavior, USB timing, startup or immunity.
release_gates: NVM image, programming fixture, readback and power-cycle enforcement are unfinished; defaults do not satisfy the specified profile.
Source entitlement, attach/detach, hard reset, undervoltage, overvoltage, short circuit and reverse blocking need actual PD/eFuse bench tests.
VDD capacitor loses substantial capacity under DC bias; cold diode drop, active PD current, reset/hold-up and depleted-pack startup require qualification.
Discharge timing depends on charger reverse paths and total effective capacitance; final timer profile and USB timing compliance remain open.
PNP saturation, eFuse slew/overshoot, resistor pulse/temperature and input inductance require physical validation.
Output capacitor bank resides in the charger block and must be placed at the eFuse/charger boundary; output negative transients remain unqualified.
Connector and IC land patterns, 3D envelope, factory test pads, placement/routing, thermal/EMI and integrated-board tests remain open.
Direct VSYS reverse current, USB-only/dead-pack/brownout handover and shared unpowered bus behavior require physical qualification.

ST specifies no ALERT leakage maximum; shared interrupt high margin is conditional on total measured leakage. I2C VIL0.35V versus other devices VOL0.4V requires actual low-level and rise-time validation.
Physical shared service pads and fixture CE inhibit/downstream isolation remain to be placed; exposed source interfaces are not manufactured test access.
Upstream OVP has typical-only delay; prove raw/guarded transients, TVS pulse energy, negative edges and maximum per-pin voltage before prototype operation outside a current-limited test setup.
The 5.9k series network current estimate scales specified 5.36k limits and is conditional, not a separately guaranteed TI test point; qualify current, startup and selectivity of cascaded limits.
TPS26600 requires close IN/GND bypass, separate RTN thermal island and no coupling to ILIM/OVP/slew; extra junction rise, nearby cell heating and enclosure temperature remain unqualified.
At sustained21V the upstream switch is specified to turn off. This is not a guarantee under a shorted switch, open divider, or arbitrary pulses; no single-fault or IEC compliance claim.
